name: quesee
displayName: QueSee: Customer Experience, Churn Risk & Quality Scoring
description: Find out why customers call, chat, open tickets and cancel. QueSee joins every call, chat, ticket, bill and network signal into one record per customer, scores conversations against your own SOP, coaches agents on the exact steps they miss, and ranks customers at risk of churning with the next step to save each one. Built for contact center, support, CX and retention teams at broadband, telecom and other service providers. Read-only, with names and contact details replaced.
